name: CCO Stress Test Corpus
description: 20 stress-test sentences designed to push parser limits using CCO vocabulary. Tests garden paths, passive deontic, stacked modals, long-distance dependencies, NER boundaries, modality edge cases, semantic role confusion, and multi-clause discourse.

sentences.sentence: The report filed by the incorporated organization described the healthcare facility.
sentences.pattern: Garden path (VBN acl vs main verb)
knownIssues: Parser may treat 'filed' as main verb instead of reduced relative clause

sentences.sentence: The certificate shall be reviewed by the geopolitical organization.
knownIssues: prescribedAgent may not resolve through passive 'by' phrase

sentences.sentence: The person should have submitted the title document.
knownIssues: Stacked modal 'should have' may not resolve tense or deontic force

sentences.sentence: The document authorized the person to access the healthcare facility.
knownIssues: F-5 should flip Document from AgentRole to PatientRole/Instrument

sentences.sentence: The person that the incorporated organization hired last year approved the certificate.
knownIssues: 'approved' may not link back to 'person' as agent across relative clause

sentences.sentence: The report the person the geopolitical organization hired wrote was approved.
knownIssues: Center embedding is known to break most parsers — expected failure

sentences.sentence: The person submitted the title document to the organization in the healthcare facility on Tuesday.
knownIssues: PP attachment ambiguity: does 'in the facility' modify org, document, or submission?

sentences.sentence: The senior analysts and persons reviewed the document.
knownIssues: 'senior' may modify only 'analysts' or both

sentences.sentence: The director, a person of the incorporated organization, approved the certificate.
knownIssues: Parser may merge appositive into single entity or emit redundant Tier 2

sentences.sentence: The organization's compliance officer submitted the person's title document.
knownIssues: Possessive 's may create entity boundary errors

sentences.sentence: Three healthcare facilities reported twelve incidents.
knownIssues: 'Three' and 'twelve' may be included in entity labels

sentences.sentence: If the person fails to submit the certificate, the incorporated organization must notify the geopolitical organization.
knownIssues: Bridge between negated antecedent and mandatory consequent may not resolve

sentences.sentence: The incorporated organization cannot fail to disclose the document.
knownIssues: Double negation 'cannot fail to' may not resolve to obligation

sentences.sentence: The organization will have reviewed the report by Friday.
knownIssues: Future perfect 'will have reviewed' may not get correct tense annotation

sentences.sentence: The geopolitical organization reviews reports every quarter.
knownIssues: Habitual aspect has no dedicated TenseAspect individual

sentences.sentence: The incorporated organization received the certificate from the person.
knownIssues: Organization may be incorrectly assigned AgentRole — receiving is not agentive in BFO

sentences.sentence: The person met the organization's representative.
knownIssues: Symmetric predicates have no clear agent/patient distinction

sentences.sentence: The person classified the document as confidential.
knownIssues: 'confidential' should be QualityAssertion, not a role

sentences.sentence: The person submitted the report. The incorporated organization reviewed it.
knownIssues: 'it' may not resolve to Report IRI — no cross-sentence coreference

sentences.sentence: The person submitted the certificate, not the title document.
knownIssues: 'not the title document' should generate Unrealized EventDescription for the TD
